hook.head: 3 things every business website needs.
hook.vo: Three things every small business website needs.

tips.n: Number one. Prices you can see.
tips.vo: Show your menu and your prices right on the page. If people have to message you to ask, many of them just leave.
tips.head: Show your prices.

tips.n: Number two. One tap to order.
tips.vo: Add one big button that opens WhatsApp with the order already written. Fewer steps means more orders.
tips.head: One tap to order.

msgs: Hi! I'd like 2 Spanish lattes for pickup at 5 pm

tips.vo: Put your location and your opening hours where nobody has to search for them. It sounds simple, but it's what people look for first.
tips.head: Map + opening hours.

visual.prompt: > where are you, and are you open?

cta.head: Save this for later.
cta.vo: Save this for later... and follow Pixel and Co, for more.
